name: world-map

frames.best_why: All five routes are fully drawn and every city dot pulses, with the heading still readable.

tagline: Blue arcs link cities across a dotted globe as it loads.
summary: A dotted map of the world with glowing location dots and curved blue routes drawn between cities, each line animating into place while every dot pulses.
appearance: A wide map of the continents built from tiny pale-blue dots on near-black. Faint blue curves lift between paired dots, each of which glows with a soft pulsing ring.
behaviour: On load the routes draw from city to city one after another while every endpoint emits a slow pulsing halo. After that nothing moves and the map does not react to the pointer.
demo_content: Heading 'Remote Connectivity' with copy about working anywhere; routes between New York, London, Tokyo and Paris.
search_phrases: dotted map of the globe with routes
office locations shown on a map
remote team spread across the world
use_when: You need to show a distributed team, offices or shipping routes and want it to feel global and alive.
avoid_when: The map is decorative only: no zoom, labels or click targets, and tiny dots fade on low-contrast screens.
customise: Pass a dots array of start and end coordinates plus a line colour; dot size, map radius and per-theme colours are set in the source.
weight_why: One generated SVG image plus a few path and circle elements, with no canvas loop.

a11y.note: The image has alt text but the routes carry no city labels, so the connections are invisible to screen readers.

polish_why: Crisp dots and clean arcs; the faint continents make the geography hard to read.
